description: This file defines an abstract class 'RuleNodeScriptEngine' implementing the 'ScriptEngine' interface, providing asynchronous script execution methods and handling script invocation and result transformation within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RuleNodeScriptEngine
classes.description: An abstract class for executing scripts asynchronously within the Thingsboard platform, parameterized by script invocation service and result type.

methods.name: RuleNodeScriptEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the script engine by evaluating the script and obtaining a script ID.

methods.name: prepareArgs
methods.description: Abstract method to prepare arguments for script execution based on a message.

methods.name: executeUpdateAsync
methods.description: Executes a script asynchronously to update and transforms the result into a list of messages.

methods.name: executeUpdateTransform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform script result into message list for update operation.

methods.name: executeGenerateAsync
methods.description: Executes a script asynchronously to generate a message, transforming the result.

methods.name: executeGenerateTransform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform script result into a generated message.

methods.name: executeFilterAsync
methods.description: Executes a script asynchronously to filter messages, returning a boolean.

methods.name: executeFilterTransform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform script result into a filter boolean.

methods.name: executeSwitchAsync
methods.description: Executes a script asynchronously to determine switch states, returning a set of strings.

methods.name: executeSwitchTransform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform script result into switch set.

methods.name: executeToStringAsync
methods.description: Executes a script asynchronously to convert result to string.

methods.name: executeToStringTransform
methods.description: Abstract method to transform script result into string.

methods.name: executeScriptAsync
methods.description: Prepares arguments and executes the script asynchronously.

methods.name: executeScriptAsync (private)
methods.description: Invokes the script with given customer ID and arguments, transforming the result.

methods.name: convertResult
methods.description: Abstract method to convert raw script invocation result into desired type.
